observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, thread-safe client and registers a bounded flush at interpreter exit. This could allow the PostHog SDK to deliver queued events without blocking the main worker thread, while still ensuring delivery before process termination. This could improve performance and prevent worker hangs in long-lived processes.
